Put the Supabase library here, so the site does not load code from another website.

NEWEST COPY (recommended, v34):
1. Open this address in your browser (it downloads or shows a long file):
   https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.117.0/dist/umd/supabase.min.js
2. Save it as  supabase.min.js  in this folder (js/vendor/).
   If your browser shows it as text, press Ctrl+S and save it with that exact name.

The old copy (supabase-2.45.0.min.js) stays here as a backup. The site tries supabase.min.js first
and uses the old copy only if the new one is missing.
Do not use any other address: the site's security rules block scripts from other websites.
